newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Cyprus offers up to 12 million in 91 day t-bills.
newsitem.headline: Cyprus offers up to 12 million in 91 day t-bills.

text.p: The Central Bank of Cyprus will offer up to 12 million pounds in 91-day treasury bills with a January 8 issue date, it said in a statement on Monday.

Bids can be competitive or non-competitive and can be made from January 7 to January 8 at 0900 local time (0700 GMT). Competitive bids will be accepted in part or in whole if the price is equal or higher than that set by the central bank.
Those making non-competitive bids will pay the average price of all competitive bids submitted and accepted by the central bank.
The deadline expires at 0700 GMT on Tuesday, December 31 for the submission of bids for up to 100 million pounds of 91-day bills on offer by the central bank which have a January 1 issue date.
